reason: A macOS notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness that alerts users when a top-level model response finishes and awaits input, using a system banner and bundled audio.

summaries.zh: 当 DeepSeek Harness 顶层对话完成回复并等待输入时，通过 macOS 系统通知和提示音提醒用户。
summaries.en: Alerts users through a macOS system notification and audio prompt when a top-level DeepSeek Harness conversation finishes responding and awaits input.

capabilities: Monitors DeepSeek Harness agent status events
Displays macOS system notifications when top-level conversations become idle
Plays a bundled audio alert through the macOS afplay utility
Invokes macOS shell utilities osascript and afplay
